summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in its own shares conducted on 4 June 2026. The issuer purchased 2,500,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 100.0721 pence per share, with a high of 100.75 pence and low of 98.90 pence. These purchases are part of an existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled, reducing share count and returning capital to shareholders. The filing is a routine buyback update under Market Abuse Regulation rules. No premium or special terms apply; watch for continuation of the programme.
